title: Chicken Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful chicken stir fry made with chicken, vegetables, and a hint of Filipino spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the snow peas to the skillet and cook until tender, about 1-2 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and add the Filipino-style stir-fry seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Stir everything together and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
